title: •I Can’t Believe He’s Gone
caption: •I Can’t Believe He’s Gone (V)
game_text: If Obi-Wan is out of play (and not on table), use 1 Force to deploy on table. During battle, may use 1 Force to add 5 to your total power there for remainder of turn. Once per turn, if Luke a captive, may activate 1 Force. {control}
lore: Even though Luke felt the pain of losing his mentor, Obi-Wan continued to give him strength and guidance through the Force.

notes: Unique. Banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT with NO grabber box (grabber false; printed base is also an Immediate Effect). Curly apostrophes in the slip title/caption (Can’t, He’s); wiki page titles use straight ones. Red circle-slash C at the end → {control}. Margin credits printed vertically, one line each: left 'Original concept by Greg Shaw', right 'Mystic Visions 2003'. Lore matches the scan (no quotes/apostrophes). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the 2001 SE-style form, read off the V21 remake (745 px). Modern: V21-L-icantbelievehesgone.gif (745 px, a later PC remake as an EFFECT — same art, different bottom half); VB1 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
